decks.name: Donatello
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set turtles. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Donatello
hero.specialAbility:
INVENTIVE
When you maneuver, you may draw 2 cards instead of 1. If you do, put a card in your hand on the bottom of your deck.
After you play an invention, tuck it under this card.

cards.title: Short Circuit
cards.immediateText: Cancel all AFTER COMBAT effects on your opponent's card.

cards.title: Electro Grenade
cards.basicText: INVENTION (while tucked under Donatello's hero card): Add +1 to the value of your attacks.
cards.duringText: Remove up to 4 attack or versatile cards in your discard pile from the game. Add +1 to this card's value for each card removed.

cards.title: Thinking Ahead
cards.afterText: If you won the combat, you may put a card in your discard pile on the bottom of your deck.

cards.title: The Future of Ninjutsu
cards.basicText:
Look at the top card of any deck. You may put it on the bottom.
Draw 1 card.
Gain 1 action.

cards.title: Self Defense Grid
cards.basicText: INVENTION (while tucked under Donatello's hero card): Add +1 to the value of your defenses.
cards.afterText: Remove up to 4 defense or versatile cards in your discard pile from the game. Donatello recovers that much health.

cards.title: Bo Staff
cards.afterText: Deal 1 damage to an opposing fighter adjacent to Donatello. Draw 1 card.

cards.title: Donatello Does Machines
cards.basicText:
You and each other friendly player may return an attack, versatile, or defense card in their discard pile to their hand.
Draw 1 card.

cards.title: Quick Strike
cards.afterText: Draw 1 card.

cards.title: Party Wagon!
cards.basicText: Move a friendly fighter up to 5 spaces. They may move through opposing fighters. Then, deal 2 damage to an opposing fighter they moved through.

cards.title: Untested Enhancements
cards.duringText: Discard the bottom card of your deck. Add its BOOST value to this card's value.

cards.title: Smoke Bomb
cards.basicText:
Remove up to 4 scheme cards in your discard pile from the game. Gain that many actions.
INVENTION (while tucked under Donatello's hero card): When you play a scheme, gain 1 action.

cards.title: Shift Focus
cards.afterText: Move another fighter in Donatello's zone up to 3 spaces. They may move through other fighters.

ruleCards.title: Inventions
ruleCards.content: Electro Grenade, Self Defense Grid and Smoke Bomb are inventions (purple strip at the bottom). After you play an invention, resolve it as normal, then tuck it under Donatello's hero card instead of discarding it. While tucked, the effect on its purple strip stays active for the rest of the game. In Unbrewed, leave the card on the table next to the hero card.

decks.name: Krang
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set turtles. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Krang
hero.specialAbility:
DOOOOOM
Krang has 3 doomsday machines. Start with one machine active.
After you roll the Die of Ultimate Destruction, you can deactivate an active machine to reroll the die.
Add +1 to your move value for each active machine.

cards.title: IQ of 968
cards.basicText:
Activate all machines.
Draw [?] cards.
Krang recovers [?] health.
BOOST: Its BOOST value is [?]: roll the Die of Ultimate Destruction.

cards.title: Android Arms: Chain Flail
cards.afterText: If the printed value of your opponent's card is less than [?], or they didn't play a card, they discard 2 cards.

cards.title: Warlord of Dimension X
cards.afterText: Reveal the top card of your deck and your opponent's deck. If your card's name is longer, draw it.

cards.title: Android Arms: Powerbomb
cards.afterText: Move the opposing fighter a number of spaces up to the amount of combat damage dealt.

cards.title: Welcome to the Technodrome!
cards.immediateText:
Choose one:
► cancel all effects on your opponent's card
► activate a machine

cards.title: Android Arms: Missiles
cards.basicText: You may play this card face up as a ranged attack.

cards.title: Android Arms: Wings
cards.basicText:
Move Krang up to [?] spaces. Krang may move through opposing fighters. Then, deal 1 damage to each opposing fighter Krang moved through.
Gain 1 action.

cards.title: Minimizer
cards.immediateText: Decrease the value of your opponent's card by 4.
cards.afterText: End the turn.

cards.title: Pan-Dimensional Portal
cards.basicText: BOOST: Its BOOST value is [?]: roll the Die of Ultimate Destruction.
cards.afterText: Place a fighter in the combat in any space. They can't leave that space this turn. Both players put [?] random cards from their hands on the bottom of their decks, then both draw 2 cards.

ruleCards.title: Die of Ultimate Destruction
ruleCards.content: When you resolve an effect with the Ultimate Destruction icon (written [?] here), roll the Die of Ultimate Destruction and use the number rolled. If a card has more than one [?], roll separately for each. Rolling an X counts as 0 (no effect). A [?] BOOST value is rolled the same way when the card is used to BOOST. Without the physical die, roll 1d6 in Unbrewed and count a 6 as X (0) — this face mapping is an assumption, the die faces were not available.

ruleCards.title: Doomsday Machines
ruleCards.content: Krang has 3 doomsday machine tokens: one starts active, two inactive. Flip a token to change its state. "Activate a machine": flip an inactive one to active (if all three are active, ignore it). Deactivating one after a roll lets you reroll the die. Krang's move value is 1 + the number of active machines.

decks.name: Leonardo
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set turtles. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Leonardo
hero.specialAbility:
TEAM TACTICS
At the start of your turn, you may move any fighter 1 space.

cards.title: Eat, Sleep, and Breathe Ninjutsu
cards.afterText: Place each fighter adjacent to your fighter in another space in their zone.

cards.title: Quick Strike
cards.afterText: Draw 1 card.

cards.title: Protective Father
cards.basicText:
Splinter may swap spaces with another friendly fighter. If he does, they both recover 2 health.
Gain 1 action.

cards.title: Leonardo Leads
cards.basicText:
Move each friendly fighter up to 3 spaces.
Draw 1 card.

cards.title: I Have a Plan
cards.immediateText: You may discard 1 card. If you do, cancel all effects on your opponent's card and ignore its value.

cards.title: For Sensei
cards.afterText: Move both fighters in the combat up to 1 space each. You may discard 1 card to gain 1 action.

cards.title: Wise Beyond His Years
cards.afterText: If the opposing fighter is in fewer zones than Leonardo, deal 2 damage to the opposing fighter.

cards.title: Fearless Leader
cards.duringText: Add +2 to this card's value for each other friendly fighter adjacent to the opposing fighter.

cards.title: Spatial Awareness
cards.afterText: If the opposing fighter is in fewer zones than Splinter, deal 1 damage to the opposing fighter and draw 1 card.

decks.name: Michelangelo
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set turtles. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Michelangelo
hero.specialAbility:
PIZZA PARTY
After you attack or scheme, draw 1 card.
Your starting and maximum hand size is 3.

cards.title: Guaranteed Delivery
cards.immediateText: You may put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck to cancel all effects on your opponent's card.
cards.afterText: If your hand is empty, draw 2 cards.

cards.title: Hi-Yaaaaah!!
cards.afterText: Deal 1 damage to an adjacent opposing fighter. You may put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck to gain 1 action.

cards.title: Nunchaku
cards.basicText:
Add +1 to the value of Michelangelo's attacks this turn.
Gain 1 action.

cards.title: Shell Insertion
cards.basicText:
Choose two different effects:
► each opponent discards 1 card
► move a friendly fighter up to 2 spaces
► put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck to gain 1 action
► shuffle 2 random cards from your discard pile back into your deck

cards.title: Back for Seconds
cards.afterText: Shuffle 2 random cards from your discard pile back into your deck.

cards.title: Hard-Hitting Investigation
cards.afterText: Deal 1 damage to the opposing fighter. Gain 1 action.

cards.title: Let's Go!!
cards.afterText: Move a friendly fighter up to 3 spaces.

cards.title: Boisterous Beatdown
cards.afterText: Gain 1 action. If you won the combat, gain 2 actions instead.

cards.title: Cowabunga!!
cards.duringText: Add +1 to this card's value for each other card you played this turn.

ruleCards.title: Hand size 3
ruleCards.content: Michelangelo starts with 3 cards and his maximum hand size is 3 (discard down to 3 at the end of your turn). Unbrewed deals the normal opening hand: if it gives you 5, shuffle 2 of them back into your deck before the game starts.

decks.name: Raphael
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set turtles. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Raphael
hero.specialAbility:
ANGER ISSUES
On each of your turns, the first time you lose combat, gain 1 action.

cards.title: Payback Time!
cards.duringText: If you lost a combat this turn, this card's value is 5 instead.

cards.title: Let's Do This!
cards.afterText: Draw 1 card. If you won the combat, draw 2 cards instead.

cards.title: Unbridled Rage
cards.duringText: Discard any number of defense or versatile cards. Add +2 to this card's value for each card discarded this way.

cards.title: Slapshot
cards.duringText: If Casey is adjacent to the opposing fighter, this card's value is 6 instead.

cards.title: Raphael Is Cool but Rude
cards.basicText:
Deal 1 damage to each opposing fighter adjacent to at least one friendly fighter.
Draw 1 card.

cards.title: Crowd Control
cards.afterText: Draw 1 card for each adjacent opposing fighter. Deal 1 damage to each of those fighters.

cards.title: Relentless
cards.afterText: Shuffle this card into your deck. Then, draw 1 card.

cards.title: Break Something
cards.immediateText: Cancel all DURING COMBAT and AFTER COMBAT effects on your opponent's card.
cards.afterText: If no effects were canceled this way, deal 2 damage to an adjacent opposing fighter.

cards.title: Batter Up!
cards.afterText: If you won the combat, move the opposing fighter up to 3 spaces.

decks.name: Shredder
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set turtles. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Shredder
hero.specialAbility:
MASTER OF THE CLAN
At the start of your turn, deploy a Foot soldier to a path adjacent to a friendly fighter.
You may attack opposing fighters adjacent to Foot soldiers.
If an opponent boosts their maneuver, they may remove any Foot soldiers their hero moves through.

cards.title: Master of the Foot
cards.afterText: Deal 1 damage to each opposing fighter adjacent to a Foot soldier.

cards.title: Gruff Escort
cards.afterText: Deploy 2 Foot soldiers anywhere. Move Shredder up to 2 spaces.

cards.title: Swarming Strike
cards.duringText: Add +1 to this card's value for each adjacent Foot soldier.

cards.title: Disrupting Strike
cards.immediateText: The value of your opponent's card is equal to its printed value and cannot be changed.

cards.title: Savagery
cards.afterText: If you won the combat, deal 1 damage to each fighter adjacent to your fighter.

cards.title: Think Hard
cards.afterText: Draw 1 card for each Foot soldier adjacent to the opposing fighter.

cards.title: Back to Work!
cards.basicText: Bebop & Rocksteady recover 3 health, even if they are defeated. Place them in a space as close as possible to Shredder.

cards.title: Masterful Defense
cards.afterText: Shredder recovers 1 health for each adjacent Foot soldier.

cards.title: Long Shot
cards.duringText: If the opposing fighter is not adjacent to your fighter, this card's value is 5 instead.

cards.title: All According to Plan
cards.afterText: Your opponent gains 1 action. At the end of this turn, if they didn't play a scheme, they discard 2 cards.

cards.title: Gang Up
cards.duringText: If the opposing fighter is adjacent to 2 or more Foot soldiers, this card's value is 6 instead.

cards.title: Obedient Subjects
cards.basicText: Gain 1 action for each Foot soldier adjacent to Shredder.

cards.title: Perplexing Tactics
cards.immediateText: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card. If 10 or more Foot soldiers are deployed, also ignore that card's value.

ruleCards.title: Foot soldiers
ruleCards.content: A Foot soldier is deployed on a path: the line between two adjacent spaces (on a map without printed paths, put the token on the line joining the two spaces). Each path holds only one Foot soldier. Foot soldiers are not fighters: they cannot attack or be attacked, and fighters may move through them without stopping or taking damage. Shredder and Bebop & Rocksteady may attack any opposing fighter adjacent to a Foot soldier. When an opposing hero (not a sidekick) maneuvers and boosts, they may remove any number of Foot soldiers they move through (not with movement effects); removed Foot soldiers return to Shredder's supply. If the supply is empty, deploying does nothing.
